findings.title: Feature-flagged table visualization discards all widget results
findings.body: When `use-table-widget-visualization` is enabled, this branch renders `TableWidgetVisualization` with `columns={[]}` and an empty `tableData` object instead of passing `result.data`, `result.meta`, the widget fields, loading state, or configured columns. Every table widget for an organization with this flag will therefore render as an empty table regardless of the query result, making the feature unusable.

findings.title: Mutually exclusive age and timestamp fields are accepted when one is zero
findings.body: The exclusivity checks use truthiness (`self.initial_data.get(...)`) rather than field presence. Valid numeric zero values are falsy, so a report containing `age: 0` and `timestamp` (or `timestamp: 0` and `age`) passes validation even though the endpoint intends to reject reports mixing the two Reporting API formats. Check key presence/non-None instead so zero-valued fields do not bypass validation.

findings.title: Attribute-key query cache is not scoped to the organization
findings.body: The new React Query key contains only `queryOptions`, which has dates, projects, type, and item type but no organization slug. Unlike the previous `useApiQuery` key, it therefore aliases requests from different organizations that happen to use the same project IDs and filters. On organization navigation, cached attribute names from the prior organization can be returned before/refetch instead of the current organization's attributes, leaking metadata across organization boundaries. Include `organization.slug` (or the endpoint URL) in the query key.
